commonPrompt: Transform the supplied livery into ONE NASCAR CRAFTSMAN TRUCK SERIES racing pickup truck. Keep the reference's paint colors, sponsor identity and exact racing number, but CHANGE THE VEHICLE BODY substantially into a proper single-cab purpose-built racing pickup: taller squared cab and upright windshield, clearly separate flat covered pickup bed behind cab, wide rear fenders and short rear spoiler, blunt truck front with correct manufacturer grille. NOT a stock car, NOT a Camaro/Mustang/Camry coupe, NOT a street truck. Low racing stance, black steel racing wheels, slick Goodyear tires, front splitter, window net, roll cage and realistic race bodywork. Photoreal premium studio product rendering. Consistent front-left three-quarter angle, nose pointing left, driver's door and front grille both clearly visible. Entire truck fully in frame, centered, fills about 88% of canvas width and 48% of canvas height, wheel baseline around 75% canvas height. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background, no studio backdrop, no floor or reflection or shadow outside the vehicle, NO opaque black rectangle, no checkerboard pixels. All black body panels, tires and windows remain opaque. No separate title, no driver portrait, no human driver names; windshield banner BARL only, small CRAFTSMAN series contingency badge. Number must be exact and sponsor wordmarks clearly legible on hood and sides.
